threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still call it 'the Tube' instead of just the 'Overground' when you talk about getting around. A true Hackneyite knows it's all about the overground vibe.
Last night on the 68, a guy was arguing with a sleeping cabbie about who’s got the real London accent. Just another night, I guess.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I saw a mom calmly changing her baby on the tram floor while the driver just kept going. That's Neukölln for you.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin do you find a park where friends gather to jam with instruments while kids play around abandoned trams. It feels like summer all year.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know they're locals when they can spot the difference between a real taco joint and a tourist trap just by the line out the door.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Yesterday, a dog took a nap right on the Civic Center tracks, and Muni just had to wait it out. Classic SF chaos, isn't it?

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists always miss that the best vermut spots are tucked away in the quietest streets, not the busy plazas. It’s where locals really unwind.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: They always stand confused in front of metro maps, trying to decipher the labyrinth, while locals glide past without a second glance.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think a 10-minute walk is 'far'—everyone else’s already popped into five cafes before you reach the station.
Caught a ride on the 47 last night; a guy was singing old Bob Marley songs—everyone joined in. Never thought Brixton’s night buses had a karaoke vibe.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: I knew I was home when I saw the guy across the street using a skateboard to haul his groceries. Only in Neukölln, right?

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: You can start your night with a currywurst at 3 AM from a street vendor and end it with fresh bread from a 24-hour bakery just down the block.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: A true local knows the difference between a taco truck on 24th and one just parked at the BART. It's all about the sauce.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught the 19 this morning, and a guy serenaded us with a ukulele. He claimed he was waiting for the 'real Muni experience.' Only in SF.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think we all drink vermut on Sundays, but most locals avoid the crowds and head to quieter corner bars instead.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell by their obsession with the wrong paella recipe; they always think it’s served with chicken and chorizo, bless their hearts.
